summary: Sprint 5 Phase 2 Culinary Weekly Digest testing complete. All backend tests passed (32/32). All frontend UI elements verified working with correct data-testid attributes. Features: Settings GET/PUT with validations, Preview with HTML rendering, Generate-Now with history + in-app notifications, History list. SMTP is in demo_mode (expected - no SMTP credentials configured).

issues: Minor: Console warnings about DialogTitle accessibility - not blocking functionality

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/culinary-digest/settings returns default settings with enabled=false, all 7 sections with defaults
PUT /api/culinary-digest/settings validates frequency (weekly|biweekly|monthly), day_of_week (0-6), hour (0-23) - returns 400 for invalid values
GET /api/culinary-digest/preview returns {data, html, settings} without side-effects (no history created)
Preview HTML is non-empty string with valid HTML structure
POST /api/culinary-digest/generate-now returns {data, recipients, notified_user_ids, email_result, counts, history_id}
Generate-now creates history entry in db.culinary_digest_history with history_id starting with 'cdh_'
Generate-now creates in-app notifications for users matching recipients_roles
In demo mode (no SMTP), email_result.demo_mode=true and email_result.success=false (expected behavior)
GET /api/culinary-digest/history returns list sorted by dispatched_at descending
Disabled section (staleness=false) is excluded from preview data
Scheduler job 'culinary_digest_dispatcher' registered and visible in startup logs
Frontend: 'Weekly Digest' button visible with data-testid='open-culinary-digest-btn'
Frontend: Dialog opens with data-testid='culinary-digest-dialog' and 3 tabs (cd-tab-settings, cd-tab-preview, cd-tab-history)
Frontend: Settings tab has enabled switch, frequency/day/hour selects, role badges (owner/admin/manager), extra email input + Add button
Frontend: All 7 section switches present (exec_summary, stars_dogs, staleness, variance, low_stock, mise_en_place_gap, ai_recommendations)
Frontend: Preview tab has Load Preview button, iframe renders digest HTML with Executive Summary and Stars sections
Frontend: History tab shows dispatch entries with timestamp, window label, demo badge, email count, in-app count
Frontend: Send Now button triggers dispatch, shows toast with recipient count + in-app count, history updates
Regression: All Sprint 1-4 endpoints still work (plated-menus, buffet-factors, kitchen-beo, menu-engineering, cost-variance, convert-to-catalog)
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing data. Pame account (pamemey27@gmail.com) has 3 events, 125 guests, Test Recipe con Alérgenos for digest preview.
